<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

from collections import defaultdict
by_color = defaultdict(list)
for n in nodes:
    by_color[n['color']].append(n)

print("CURRENT STATE:")
for color, objs in sorted(by_color.items()):
    total_pixels = sum(o['pixels'] for o in objs)
    print(f"  {color}: {len(objs)} objects, {total_pixels} px")

# Check player position
if 'b' in by_color:
    player = by_color['b'][0]
    print(f"\nPlayer: boundary={player['boundary']}")
    pc = [p[1] for p in player['boundary']]
    pr = [p[0] for p in player['boundary']]
    print(f"Player cols {min(pc)}-{max(pc)}, rows {min(pr)}-{max(pr)}")

# Check wall positions
if 'S' in by_color:
    walls = by_color['S']
    print(f"\nWalls: {len(walls)}")
    for w in walls:
        print(f"  pixels={w['pixels']}, boundary={w['boundary'][:4]}...")

# Check if there's a passage the player can move through
# Try moving RIGHT to see if player can go further
print(f"\nTrying RIGHT...")
result = action(['RIGHT'])
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
player2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
pc2 = [p[1] for p in player2['boundary']]
print(f"After RIGHT: player cols {min(pc2)}-{max(pc2)}")
print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
